identity_description: Native nonblank string vaRuleId; original string preserved without deriving or coercing identity.
limitations: List POST JSON https://ifundboss-api.alipay.com/ivostro/api/virtualAccountRule/list.json with only pageNo=1/pageSize=1000. Native totalCount, unique identities and exact integer page echoes determine completeness; no speculative paging.
1000 is a qualified fixed request width, not a measured maximum. Duplicate/conflicting/truncated acquisitions remain incomplete and cannot publish on refresh.

List native resultDataList must be an array; the explicitly supported absent resultDataList with totalCount=0 means empty. Null or missing nonempty containers fail; incorrect page echoes fail even when empty.

Displayed roots preserve historical identity order: ASCII digit IDs numerically, original string tie-breaker, then other IDs lexically. All native strings, precise values, unknown fields, nulls and nested array order remain unchanged.

Get GET query /ivostro/api/virtualAccountRule/detail.json sends only vaRuleId and returns resultObj. Exact identity echo and required core business fields are validated; explicit nulls and optional vaWarningInfo remain native.
Backend refusal success=false is BUSINESS_QUERY_FAILED, never NOT_FOUND or successful empty output. Get publishes no cache and never substitutes a List row.
List countries and detail creditAreas are distinct. bankRuleId refers to a separate object; bankAccountVaRule and other relationship inquiries remain unqueried.

Only complete nonempty List refresh publishes. Live and Get never publish; failed, empty or incomplete refresh preserves the earlier capture. No bulk detail crawl, null-detail cache pairs or new Duckdog import.

List --live --with-detail fetches only selected-window VA-rule details, returns separate record/detail members and fails atomically if any selected Get is refused or invalid; saved List data stays unchanged.
